xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex054022026-02-1912-56-44" status="finalized"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3892">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3892">sa</rs><note type="editorial">Identification of sa only in ID:5990 as gloss</note></note> <expan>mngon sum</expan> la ni nges pa <expan>med</expan> pas sgro 'dogs gcod par mi byed kyi rjes su skyes pa'i nges shes kyis <expan>yin no</expan> zer ba de ni 'khrul ba yin <app><lem wit="inst:5900">te</lem><rdg wit="inst:4943">ste</rdg><rdg wit="inst:5990">te</rdg></app> 'di ltar <expan>mngon sum</expan> <lb edRef="inst:5990" n="22a5"/> gyis sgro 'dogs ma chod na yid <lb edRef="inst:4943" n="24b6"/> the tshoM za bar tshad mas grub pa'i phyir dang | rjes su skyes pa'i nges shes de tshad mar 'gyur <app><lem wit="inst:5900">te</lem><rdg wit="inst:4943">ste</rdg><rdg wit="inst:5990">te</rdg></app> khyed ltar na rtogs pa chos 3 tshang pa'i <expan>phyir ro</expan> || de 'dod na tshad ma 3 du 'gyur <app><lem wit="inst:5900">te</lem><rdg wit="inst:4943">ste</rdg><rdg wit="inst:5990">te</rdg></app> <expan>2 su</expan> <lb edRef="inst:5990" n="22a6"/> ma 'dus pa'i <expan>phyir ro</expan>||</seg></TEI>
